chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
The people missed the Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha prayers with ʿAlī عليه السلام on the day of Ṣiffīn, so he instructed them, and they recited takbīr, tahlīl, and tasbīḥ on foot and while mounted.

key_terms.رِجَالًا وَرُكْبَانًا: while on foot and while mounted
key_terms.وَهَلَّلُوا: they pronounced tahlīl, saying 'Lā ilāha illā Allāh'

ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام instruct people to do when prayers were missed on the day of Ṣiffīn?
ai.summary: This hadith describes what was done when the prescribed salat (prayer) could not be performed during the intense circumstances of the day of Ṣiffīn. It indicates a form of dhikr in place of the missed prayer in a situation of fear, movement, and military engagement.
